data.desc: Magic Empire Global Limited is a financial services provider offering corporate finance advisory services primarily through our Hong Kong subsidiaries. Our service offerings mainly comprise (i) IPO sponsorship services; (ii) financial advisory and independent financial advisory services; (iii) compliance advisory services; and (iv) corporate services. Going forward, we intend to expand into the international trade of timber raw materials, procuring timber from Africa and selling it to material processing plants in Asia for further industrial processing.
